body.purpose: Default text for forms, lists and descriptive copy.

title.purpose: Page and section hierarchy without display typography.

label.purpose: Compact task metadata and control labels.

shadows.name: overlay-only
shadows.purpose: Menus, popovers and confirmation overlays only.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Hover and menu state feedback; disable non-essential transitions for reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The primary action for a focused task such as starting a crawl or saving settings.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: #0096FA; color: #FFFFFF; font: 500 14px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #0077D1; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0096FA; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:active { background: #005A9E; }

components.name: Account Trigger
components.description: Sidebar footer trigger combining the current Pixiv avatar, ID and account menu.
components.css: .ds-account-trigger { display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; gap: 8px; padding: 6px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #333333; font: 500 14px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-avatar { display: grid; width: 32px; height: 32px; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; background: #E5F5FF; color: #0077D1; } .ds-account-id { overflow: hidden; flex: 1; text-align: left; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-account-trigger:hover { background: #E5F5FF; } .ds-account-trigger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0096FA; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Single-line source ID or search input; actual app uses the matching Naive UI input.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" placeholder="输入小说 ID 或 URL" />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 34px; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid #E0E0E6; border-radius: 6px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #333333; font: 400 14px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #777777; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #80CCFF; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #0096FA; outline: 2px solid #E5F5FF; outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation Item
components.description: Compact left navigation that makes the current work area immediately identifiable.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: block; padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: 6px; color: #444444; font: 500 14px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #E5F5FF; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0096FA; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-item-current { color: #0077D1; background: #E5F5FF; }

components.name: Task Status
components.description: Text-first task state paired with a compact progress indicator; semantic status colors are owned by Naive UI.
components.css: .ds-task-status { display: grid; gap: 4px; color: #333333; font: 400 12px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-task-status strong { color: #444444; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-task-status span { color: #777777; }

narrative.overview: A refined, reliable and efficient local workspace. Naive UI provides the shared interaction vocabulary; Pixiv Blue is reserved for actions and focus, while motion only explains state changes.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Pixiv Blue is the sole product accent; semantic success, warning and error colors retain their Naive UI meanings.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Shadows belong to overlays, not ordinary cards or lists.

dos: Use #0096FA through a shared Naive UI theme configuration.
Use short 180–200ms state transitions and reduce them when motion is reduced.
Keep account, task progress and failures immediately scannable.
donts: Don't use marketing-page visuals, social-feed layouts or decorative downloader effects.
Don't use gradient text, colored side stripes, default glassmorphism or nested cards.
Don't use Pixiv Blue to replace semantic success, warning or error states.
